evidence.quote: As noted in our 2024 Annual Report, Anand Aithal joined the Board as an Independent Non-Executive Director on 1 January 2025. Annemarie Durbin was appointed as Senior Independent Director from 1 May 2025.

initiatives.name: Charles Church Premium Brand Scaling
initiatives.summary: Targeting to double the scale of Charles Church premium brand business, with completions already up 16% in 2025. Expansion includes new regions and dual-branded sites, growing from 48 to 64 outlets.

evidence.title: Charles Church brand expansion strategy
evidence.summary: Targeting to double the scale of Charles Church premium brand business, with completions already up 16% in 2025. Expansion includes new regions and dual-branded sites, growing from 48 to 64 outlets.
evidence.quote: The relaunch of Charles Church, our premium brand, has generated real momentum, with completions up 16% in 2025. Customers have embraced our new house types and enhanced specifications, supporting the premium pricing Charles Church achieves and demonstrating the opportunity to drive further growth in this market segment. Indeed, we closed the year with 64 Charles Church outlets, up from 48, including 41 dual-branded sites. Our medium-term target remains to double Charles Church's contribution to the Group.

initiatives.name: Space4 Factory Automation Program
initiatives.summary: Installation of new automated timber frame line and first-in-industry automated roof truss line at Space4 Birmingham facility. The custom-built production line uses 3D designs and software to minimize waste and improve safety, accuracy and consistency.

evidence.title: New automated robotic technology at Space4 factory
evidence.summary: Installation of new automated timber frame line and first-in-industry automated roof truss line at Space4 Birmingham facility. The custom-built production line uses 3D designs and software to minimize waste and improve safety, accuracy and consistency.
evidence.quote: During the year we installed new automated and robotic technology at our existing Space4 facility in Birmingham. The investment means we are able to deliver a more advanced product more safely, with higher accuracy and consistency and less wastage. The production line has been custom built for our house types with our 3D designs fed into the software, which works out how much material is needed with minimal waste, resulting in a more sustainable way of building. We are the first developer to install an automated roof truss line with certification achieved in November 2025, and the first deliveries to site due early in 2026.

initiatives.name: Nexus ReGen Materials Exchange Platform Partnership
initiatives.summary: Signed nationwide contract with Nexus ReGen for digital platform enabling sustainable reuse of construction materials. Persimmon is first housebuilder to mandate Materials Exchange Platform Group-wide to reduce carbon emissions and waste.

evidence.title: Nexus ReGen Materials Exchange Platform contract
evidence.summary: Signed nationwide contract with Nexus ReGen for digital platform enabling sustainable reuse of construction materials. Persimmon is first housebuilder to mandate Materials Exchange Platform Group-wide to reduce carbon emissions and waste.
evidence.quote: Following a successful trial of the Nexus ReGen Materials Exchange Platform ('MEP'), in November 2025, Persimmon signed a nationwide contract with them. Nexus ReGen is the UK's leading digital platform for the sustainable reuse of construction materials. Persimmon is the first housebuilder to mandate an MEP Group-wide, signalling a shift towards circular construction at scale. The objective of this partnership is to reduce carbon emissions, material waste and reliance on landfills.

initiatives.name: Brickworks Capacity Expansion
initiatives.summary: Implementation of third shift operations and plans for additional production line at Brickworks factory to meet growing demand. Factory now operates 24/7 with new line opening in 2027.

evidence.title: Brickworks capacity expansion program
evidence.summary: Implementation of third shift operations and plans for additional production line at Brickworks factory to meet growing demand. Factory now operates 24/7 with new line opening in 2027.
evidence.quote: To meet the increasing demand for our next-generation brick during the year, we implemented a third shift at the Brickworks facility. Brickworks delivered c.60 million bricks, 23% more than in 2024, to 258 sites during 2025. With the factory now operating, 24 hours a day and seven days a week, plans are in place to further expand capacity in 2026 by introducing an additional production line, opening in 2027.

evidence.title: Tileworks third shift expansion
evidence.summary: Planning to introduce third shift at Tileworks tile manufacturing facility to meet 54% increase in demand. This will enhance cost efficiency for the vertically integrated operation.
evidence.quote: Our own tile is now our preferred option for every region, except where local planning rules require an alternative product. Demand again grew in 2025, with c.12 million tiles, 54% more than in 2024, delivered to 282 sites. We anticipate adding a third shift this year, further enhancing cost efficiency.

initiatives.name: Science-Based Net Zero Targets Commitment
initiatives.summary: Company has SBTi-approved near-term targets of 46% operational emissions reduction and 22% per m2 Scope 3 reduction by 2030, with long-term commitment to net zero by 2045. Comprehensive decarbonization pathway in place.

evidence.title: Science-based net zero carbon targets commitment
evidence.summary: Company has SBTi-approved near-term targets of 46% operational emissions reduction and 22% per m2 Scope 3 reduction by 2030, with long-term commitment to net zero by 2045. Comprehensive decarbonization pathway in place.
evidence.quote: We have developed a clear decarbonisation pathway with the ambition to become a net zero carbon business by 2045. To underpin this, we have already established and received approval for science-based targets to be achieved by 2030: a 46% reduction in operational emissions from a 2019 baseline, and a 22% reduction in the carbon intensity of our indirect emissions (including homes in use and goods and services) per square metre of completed floor area, using a 2019 baseline.

evidence.title: Launch of Persimmon Data & AI Academy pilot
evidence.summary: Company is launching a pilot Data & AI Academy to build practical AI capability across the organization, with applications in compliance, site management, and land assessment. The first cohort begins training in March 2026.
evidence.quote: We are looking to innovate and further increase our use of AI, including seeking out new opportunities to leverage advanced tools for compliance, site management, and land assessment. By exploring AI-powered insights, we aim to strengthen decision making and enhance operational efficiency across our core business areas. To support this, we have launched a pilot Persimmon Data & AI Academy to build practical, immediately usable data and AI capability across the organisation. The first cohort of colleagues will begin their training in March.
